verdict.rationale: LocalAI ships its own natural-language agent, `local-ai chat`. It runs in the user's shell, reads files and executes commands behind an approval gate, so the product can be driven conversationally. However, no evidence shows that this agent is meant to administer LocalAI itself, such as installing models, configuring backends or managing nodes through natural language. That use is only implied by its general shell-command ability. Missing for 10: documented natural-language control of LocalAI's own management functions (model gallery, configuration, agents), examples of NL-driven product operations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: local-ai chat reads your files and runs commands on your machine, behind an approval gate you control.
`local-ai chat`, an agent in your shell that runs commands behind an approval gate.
It answers questions, reads your files and runs commands on your machine, asking you to approve anything that changes state.
